answer: Because the mirror derivation is checked against the whisper nonce, the violet audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 33 aliases produces 33 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 18 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
